input.subject: Additional documents needed for Al Manar Logistics registration
input.body:
Dear Faisal,

Thank you for your registration documents. To complete onboarding we need:

1. GOSI certificate: the attached nitaqat_gosi.pdf was unreadable. Please send a clear, legible copy.
2. Zakat certificate: not received. Please send a copy.

Please reply to this email with the documents attached.

Best regards,
Procurement Team
